population: Public itch.io project launches and creator discovery documentation; not observed paying buyers or wishlist events
unit: Documented publication/indexing event or audience-notification condition; not paid unit, unique human, or purchase conversion
period: 2026-10-27 public policy observation; project/sale publisher events are hypothetical
sample_frame: Official itch.io search-indexing, quality, followers and sale documentation

release_event_distinctions.notes: Unpublished draft is not a launch observation.
Direct and profile links can work before new paid-seller review; the site may review indexing.
Eligible search/browse presence does not measure impression count or paid demand.

creator_controls.effect: Feed updates, potential new-game notification email, sale notice for eligible nonowners, subject to account notification preferences
User-curated page listing and possible visibility signals described by the operator
Separate indexed update and distribution through feeds/email digests
Configured start/end window and badges on participating project

measurement_limitations: A collection is not proof of a native platform wishlist or a reliable preorder-intent count; the operator documents collection and follow pathways.
Follower notification eligibility and platform messaging do not imply receipt, email open, new visitor, or purchase.
Publication date is fixed; indexing delay means a project's first browse appearance can occur after initial publication.
Sale badges and page promotion are not randomized uplift experiments.
Most Recent appearance or rank is not guaranteed and cannot be treated as durable launch visibility.
Observed first-month order denominators and same-title cohort comparisons require owner consent and purchase logs; no such data were acquired.
